verses.text: So now, made right with God through faith, we’ve got peace with God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Through him, faith brought us into this grace where we’re standing. And we’re celebrating the hope of sharing God’s glory. ✨
And that’s not even all—we can find joy in our hard times too, because suffering builds endurance;
endurance shapes proven character, and proven character grows hope.
Hope won’t leave us embarrassed, because God poured his love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit he gave us. 💛
While we were still powerless, right on time, Christ died for people who were far from God.
Most people wouldn’t die for someone righteous. Maybe somebody would risk it for a truly good person.
But God put his love on full display: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
Since we’ve now been made right by his blood, how much more will he save us from God’s anger through him!
When we were enemies, God brought us back through his Son’s death. Now that we’re reconciled, how much more will his life save us!
And we’re not done celebrating: through our Lord Jesus Christ, we celebrate God himself. Through Jesus, we’ve received this reconciliation.
Here’s how sin entered the world: one man brought sin in, and death came through sin. Death spread to everyone, because all sinned.
Sin was already around before the Law, but without a law, sin isn’t counted as breaking one.
Still, death ruled from Adam to Moses—even over people whose sin wasn’t like Adam’s disobedience. Adam pointed ahead to the one who was coming.
But the free gift isn’t a replay of the trespass. One man’s trespass brought death to many; God’s grace and the gift through Jesus Christ overflowed to many more.
The gift isn’t like what happened through the one sinner: one sin brought condemnation, but after countless sins came the free gift that makes people right.
If death ruled through one man’s trespass, how much more will those receiving overflowing grace and the gift of righteousness rule in life through Jesus Christ!
So here’s the contrast: one trespass brought condemnation to everyone; one righteous act brought justification and life to everyone.
One man’s disobedience made many sinners; one man’s obedience will make many righteous.
The Law came in so trespasses would pile up. But where sin piled up, grace overflowed even more. 🌊
So just as sin ruled through death, grace can now rule through righteousness and bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
